make_dmc_environment: create a DeepMind Control Suite environment with configurable observation type, frame stacking, and action repeat
create_action_repeat_wrapper: build an ActionRepeatWrapper that repeats the same action multiple times and accumulates reward and discount
create_frame_stack_wrapper: build a FrameStackWrapper that stacks multiple frames along the channel axis for pixel observations
create_flatten_jaco_wrapper: build a FlattenJacoObservationWrapper that flattens Jaco robot observations into a single vector and extracts pixels
create_extended_timestep: build an ExtendedTimeStep NamedTuple that wraps DM env timesteps with action and physics state
